qualification.details: Young Professional-II (YP-II): Essential: Post graduates in Seed Science and Technology, Genetics and Plant Breeding, Plant Physiology, Botany, Biotechnology/Molecular Biology, Vegetable/Horticulture or other allied disciplines of Agricultural Sciences or professional Graduates in (B.E./B.Tech.) in relevant subjects. Desirable: Hands-on experience in seed quality testing in a functional seed testing/quality-control laboratory; Experience in seed quality enhancement and seed treatment research; Proficiency in computer application skills (MS Office and IT tools) and in the use of standard statistical packages. Young Professional-I (YP-I): Essential: Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university with good academic record. Desirable: Working knowledge of computer and MS office and or Hands on experience of working on seed/planting materials/ seed testing and or Agricultural/Plant Sciences field/ laboratory work Skilled Labor: Essential: 10th pass with experience in agricultural research activities such as field experimentation, seed production, sample collection and processing, maintenance of experimental plots, data recording and entry, and operation of basic agricultural or laboratory equipment will be preferred. Un-Skilled Labor: Essential: <10th pass. Candidates having 5-6 years of experience in agricultural field and laboratory work, including field operations, data entry and record keeping, sample collection and handling, controlled pollination and other related agricultural research activities, will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ICAR IARI?
faq.answer: ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute has announced a total of 5 vacancies for various posts including Young Professional-II, Young Professional-I, Skilled Labor, and Un-Skilled Labor.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 11 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the candidates?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all posts is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: For the Young Professional-II post, candidates must be Post Graduates in Seed Science and Technology, Genetics and Plant Breeding, Plant Physiology, Botany, Biotechnology/Molecular Biology, Vegetable/Horticulture, or allied Agricultural Sciences, or professional Graduates in B.E./B.Tech. in relevant subjects.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Young Professional-II post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ICAR IARI recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI recruitment going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute, Karnal, Haryana, Pin Code: 132002.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview, Document Verification, and final selection by a Committee.
